summary: Iteration 2 additive testing: 13/13 backend tests pass (Order detail w/ items+timeline, Labels PDF w/ %PDF- magic bytes + auth/empty/unknown branches, threshold PATCH + 422 + 404, store PATCH partner creds + write-only partner_key, GET/PUT settings incl. clear-to-null, webhook does not 500 and returns low_stock_alerts_sent). Shopee sync worker startup log confirmed. Frontend: drawer opens from row click (checkbox click does NOT open), tracking/items/timeline populated (screenshot verified); batch print produces real PDF Blob download; 0-selected triggers error toast; inventory threshold-{id} inline editor persists + row reflects new value; Stores slack-card ACTIVE/OFF pill toggles on save; store edit modal saves partner_id/partner_key/shop_id+sync toggle and card shows Auto-Sync ON. Iteration 1 regressions still pass (login/logout, /dashboard unauth -> /login). Post-test state reset: store 1 sync_enabled=false, sku 1 threshold=80, slack webhook cleared.
critical_code_review_comments: Order.tracking_number is not populated in POST /api/webhooks/orders (schema OrderWebhookPayload lacks tracking_number and the code does not set order.tracking_number). Legacy orders were backfilled by seed, so drawer works today, but any brand-new order created via webhook will show a null tracking number and the PDF label will print 'TRK-PENDING'. Consider adding tracking_number to the webhook payload or generating one.

shopee_sync._sync_cycle_sync uses asyncio.run() inside an already-running event loop context — if a store is ever sync_enabled=True this will raise RuntimeError('asyncio.run() cannot be called from a running event loop') because sync_loop() awaits it via the outer loop. It works today only because no store has sync_enabled=True. Suggest awaiting _pull_orders_for_store directly from sync_loop and making _sync_cycle async, or run the sync body inside asyncio.to_thread().

OrderDrawer keeps the aside always mounted in the DOM and only translates it off-screen; consumers using `[data-testid=order-drawer]` to detect open/closed state must instead inspect `translate-x-0` class. Minor testability nit.
seed_data_creation: None; used seeded orders/SKUs/stores. Test data resets performed post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers iteration-2 endpoints. To retest low-stock Slack path with a real Slack URL, PUT /api/settings then POST /api/webhooks/orders with a marketplace_sku_code mapped in store 1 that will drop stock at/below threshold. shopee_sync worker uses asyncio.run() inside async loop — do not enable sync on any store during automated tests without addressing the RCA note above.
